standard.summary: 自动将不同宽高比的图片分配到不同分辨率桶（Aspect Ratio Bucket）中训练。同一 batch 内图片分辨率相近，不同 batch 可以分辨率不同。避免强制缩放导致的图像拉伸或裁切，保留原始构图信息。
standard.effect: 开启后竖图和横图混合训练时效果显著——模型学到更自然的宽高比泛化。例如训练数据有 3:4 竖图和 16:9 横图，bucket 会让它们分别进入不同的 (768,1024) 和 (1024,576) 桶，而不是全部 resize 到 1024×1024。

recommendedValues.enable_bucket: true（推荐几乎所有场景开启）
recommendedValues.bucket_reso_steps: 64（标准值，控制桶的分辨率粒度）
recommendedValues.bucket_no_upscale: true（防止小图被放大产生模糊）

standard.whenToUse: 训练数据宽高比差异大时必开。竖图和横图混合训练时效果显著。即使所有图都是 1:1 也不会产生负面影响。
standard.avoidWhen: bucket_no_upscale=False 时小图会被放大到最小桶分辨率，可能产生模糊——建议设为 true 或在数据预处理阶段就裁切好。bucket_custom_resos 允许手动指定桶分辨率列表，但通常自动计算就够用了。

standard_en.summary: Sorts images of different aspect ratios into different resolution buckets (Aspect Ratio Bucket) for training. Within a batch resolutions are close; between batches they can differ. It avoids the stretching and cropping that forced resizing causes, keeping the original composition.
standard_en.effect: The effect is pronounced when portrait and landscape images train together -- the model generalises across aspect ratios more naturally. With 3:4 portrait and 16:9 landscape data, bucketing sends them to separate (768,1024) and (1024,576) buckets instead of resizing everything to 1024x1024.
standard_en.whenToUse: Essential when aspect ratios vary widely, and clearly beneficial when portrait and landscape images are mixed. It does no harm even when every image is 1:1.
standard_en.avoidWhen: With bucket_no_upscale=False, small images are enlarged to the smallest bucket resolution and may blur -- set it to true, or crop properly during data preparation. bucket_custom_resos lets you give the bucket resolutions by hand, though the automatic calculation is usually enough.

recommendedValues.max_bucket_reso: 2048 (the default), or adjusted to your VRAM
recommendedValues.bucket_reso_steps: 64 (the standard value, controlling bucket resolution granularity)
recommendedValues.bucket_no_upscale: true (stops small images being enlarged into blur)

advanced.principle: Bucket 算法：(1) 对每张图片按 area 缩放到接近 resolution² 的 scale，得到 (w', h')；(2) 将 w' 和 h' 分别 round 到最近的 bucket_reso_steps 倍数；(3) clamp 到 [min_bucket_reso, max_bucket_reso] 范围。同一 batch 内必须分辨率相同以保证 tensor shape 对齐——DataLoader 使用 BucketBatchSampler 按桶分组采样。
advanced.intervention: 替换默认 SequentialSampler 为 BucketBatchSampler。collate_fn 不再做 resize/pad，直接 stack 同桶内的 (C, H, W) tensor。bucket_selection_mode='aspect'（默认）按宽高比选桶，'area' 按面积选桶。
advanced.expectedImpact: 保留原始宽高比信息，模型学到更自然的构图。对生成图像的默认宽高比泛化有帮助——不开 bucket 的模型倾向于只擅长生成正方形图像。实测对 FID 改善约 1-3%，但对 prompt 中的宽高比控制能力改善更显著。
advanced.tradeoffs: resolution_aware_batch_enabled 可以根据桶分辨率动态调整 batch_size——小分辨率桶用更大 batch（因为显存占用小），大分辨率桶用更小 batch。这能在总显存不变的情况下提高吞吐量。bucket_reso_steps 越小桶越多（更精确的宽高比匹配），但每个桶的样本数可能太少导致 batch 凑不齐。

advanced_en.principle: Bucket algorithm: (1) scale each image by area close to resolution² to get (w', h'); (2) round w' and h' each to the nearest bucket_reso_steps multiple; (3) clamp to [min_bucket_reso, max_bucket_reso]. Same-resolution images within a batch are required for tensor-shape alignment — the DataLoader uses BucketBatchSampler to sample grouped by bucket.
advanced_en.intervention: Replaces the default SequentialSampler with BucketBatchSampler. collate_fn no longer resizes/pads — it directly stacks same-bucket (C, H, W) tensors. bucket_selection_mode='aspect' (default) picks buckets by aspect ratio; 'area' by area.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Preserves original aspect ratios, so the model learns more natural composition. Helps generalize the default aspect ratio of generated images — without buckets the model tends to only generate square images well. Measured ~1-3% FID improvement, but the improvement in controlling aspect ratio via prompts is more significant.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: resolution_aware_batch_enabled can adjust batch_size dynamically per bucket resolution — larger batches for small-resolution buckets (less VRAM), smaller for large ones, raising throughput at constant total VRAM. Smaller bucket_reso_steps means more buckets (finer aspect matching) but buckets may hold too few samples to fill a batch.
